name: Rye
intro: Rye is the pivot point of the lower Peninsula  -  the last town before Sorrento and Portsea, the first one where the landscape really opens up to the Southern Ocean. The front beach is a long bay-calm stretch with a pier and a century of summer memory behind it; the back beach is where you drive to in ten minutes to remind yourself that the ocean side is an entirely different country. In between sits a main street that has quietly improved itself over the past five years, a brewery precinct in the hills above the town, and Peninsula Hot Springs close enough to slot into an afternoon without rearranging the day. Rye is where families have always come to do nothing in particular, and that remains the right instinct.
factualLede: Rye is a coastal town on the Mornington Peninsula's southern Port Phillip shore, 90 km from Melbourne, with a back beach on Bass Strait, the Rye Pier, and a foreshore that fills with summer holidaymakers.

heroImage.alt: Rye pier and calm front beach at dusk with the ridge rising behind

tldr: Rye is the Peninsula's two-beach town — calm bay front, wild ocean back, with Peninsula Hot Springs and a brewery in between.
Best for: families who want both bay and ocean in one base; divers; visitors who want Peninsula Hot Springs without driving further south.
Signature experience: morning swim on the front beach, afternoon at Peninsula Hot Springs, back beach walk at dusk.
Full day or overnight; the most practical base for the lower Peninsula outside Sorrento.
bestFor: families who want bay and ocean access
notFor: people wanting a refined village feel
signature: The Peninsula town that gives you the calm bay, the surf beach and the hot springs without making you choose.
skip: The busiest stretch of the front beach in peak season — head further along the sand or go early.
bestDay: Front-beach swim at breakfast, slow lunch in town, hot springs in the afternoon, back beach for sunset.
insiderNote: If you want Rye at its best, use it as a base and leave the beach-hopping to the edges of the day.
